author: IGN
description:
Take a look at a gameplay demo for Warframe: Tau, Warframe's next major narrative chapter. Reach beyond the bounds of the Origin System and venture into a new Star Chart, the Tau System. Once a paradise built by the Sentients, Tau has been lost to war and ruin. Nowhere is this felt more keenly than on the black rain-soaked streets of Fornax, a colossal Sentient ring city. Here, the devastating downpour and its maddening influence run in rivulets from the heights of the Hunra's gambling dens, through the Docks, and into the most desperate Slums — where the residents have turned to the mind-altering Bloom in search of escape.
There, Albrecht Entrati awaits the arrival of the Tenno after conscripting the inner monologuing and noir-inspired Warframe, Brysko, to infiltrate the Hunra's criminal underworld — a final gamble to avert Fornax falling to those with nothing to lose. Get ready to risk it all.

#ign #gaming
title: Warframe: Tau - Official Gameplay Demo | TennoCon 2026

author: IGN
description:
If Rockstar won't make Bully, then dang it, developer Refugium Games is going to give it their best college try. Or in this case, high school try, as Agefield High: Rock the School puts you in high school in the early 2000's in a coming-of-age adventure. It will be released for PC on August 12. It'll hit consoles later. Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3562580/Agefield_High_Rock_the_School/
